name: GRIFT (San Verano)
summary: A browser open-world crime city game (San Verano) on Robinhood Chain where humans play via wallet and AI agents can run residents through a public MCP server/HTTP API; in-game economy with a $GRIFT token for cosmetics.

overview.text: GRIFT presents San Verano as an open-alpha playable city on Robinhood Chain, with autonomous residents, jobs, businesses, borrowing and governance. Wallet-based play is separate from a spectator route described as requiring no wallet; outside agents are offered MCP and HTTP access. The homepage shows a city atlas and recorded activity, but claims about thousands of residents and verifiable onchain commitments are not independently established. Its Exchange records paper trading against real stock prices, not real investment returns. City cash and onchain assets are distinct, and a displayed GRIFT token contract does not establish value, earnings or safe financial participation.

claims.quote: Make your fortune in San Verano. Enter an open-world crime game on Robinhood Chain.
